projection: Simple cylindrical, planetocentric; GeoTIFF easting/northing resampled to -180 to 180 degrees east and 90 to -90 degrees north

encoding.channels: 8-bit full-resolution RGB, identity matrix; sRGB primaries/transfer

processing: Linear-light Lanczos reduction on the original georeferenced grid. Extend the single exterior NoData row from its nearest valid row and wrap longitude filtering. No sharpening, new terrain or palette editing.
limitations: Merged multi-date Galileo colour-ratio and Voyager/Galileo monochrome mosaic. Spatial source resolution varies from 1 to 10 km. Published IR/green/violet ratios and inherited polar fill are not calibrated natural colour or an exact 1979 surface.
control: Development-only 4096 x 2048 reduction of the same prepared image, AVIF quality 90; isolates encoding and resolution from source changes.
